system.description: Invokers prepare supernatural effects that bind power into creatures, objects, locations, and declared conditions. In Combat, they establish Wards, Hexes, Divinations, Imbuements, Offerings, and other Rites, then exploit the moments when those Rites are fulfilled. Their strength comes from preparation, prediction, and maintaining the right combination of effects as the Encounter changes.
system.benefit: Gain access to the Ritualism Combat Style. If this Distinction is acquired later, gain access to Ritualism, increase it to Rank 2, then gain one additional Ritualism Expertise and two additional Ritualism Combat Cards.

origin.name: Final Echo
origin.text: You may maintain one additional Rite. Once per round, when you remove one of your Rites to establish another, you may resolve the removed Rite's Echo once before removing it. Ignore its Trigger and choose any valid target or area.
